description: Für die UPB werden im jährlichen bzw. zweijährlichen Rhythmus Proben aus der Umwelt entnommen. Die Ergebnisse sind nach Qualitätskontrolle, Qualitätssicherung und Plausibilitätskontrolle im UPB-Analysen-Importformat (Excel-Files für den Import in die UBA-Datenbank) zu liefern. title: Udbud af kontrakt vedrørende levering, drift, vedligeholdelse, support og videreudvikling af et internetbaseret bookingsystem til Forsvarets Puljekøretøjer
description: Forsvarsministeriets Materiel- og Indkøbsstyrelse (”FMI) ønsker at indgå en kontrakt vedrørende levering, drift, vedligeholdelse, support og videreudvikling af et internetbaseret bookingsystem til Forsvarets Puljekøretøjer. Det eksisterende system ønskes erstattet af en mere moderne, driftssikker og brugervenlig løsning, der understøtter effektiv booking, udlån og returnering af puljekøretøjer samt giver FMI adgang til relevante drifts- og administrationsdata. Formålet med kontrakten er at sikre Forsvaret en samlet løsning, der med et minimum af ressourceforbrug fra FMI muliggør en sikker, fleksibel og effektiv forvaltning af puljekøretøjer på tværs af organisationen. Løsningen skal understøtte både åbne og lukkede køretøjspuljer, kunne håndtere et stort antal brugere og køretøjer samt bidrage til høj tilgængelighed og kontinuitet i Forsvarets transportløsninger. Kontrakten omfatter leverandørens levering, drift, vedligeholdelse, support og videreudvikling af det samlede system, herunder såvel applikationen som den dertil nødvendige infrastruktur, til brug for Forsvarets puljekøretøjer samt levering, installation og drift af elektronisk delebiludstyr i køretøjerne. Kontrakten inkluderer en opstartsperiode bestående af en udviklingsperiode og en implementeringsperiode, hvor systemet tilpasses, udvikles og idriftsættes i overensstemmelse med FMI’s krav. Leverandøren er ansvarlig for levering af applikationen samt for den dertil nødvendige infrastruktur, herunder hosting af systemet på servere beliggende i Danmark. Systemet leveres som en internetbaseret løsning (SaaS), og leverandøren er ansvarlig for al drift af den bagvedliggende infrastruktur. Leverandøren er ansvarlig for integration af eksisterende data om brugere, puljer, puljekøretøjer og bookinger samt for eventuel genanvendelse af allerede installeret elektronisk delebiludstyr. Systemet skal understøtte selvbetjent adgang for brugere, omfattende administrations- og rapporteringsfunktioner for FMI samt teknisk support og døgnbemandet helpdesk. Kontrakten løber i 72 måneder fra underskrift. Kontrakten kan forlænges på samme vilkår med op til 2 gange 24 måneder. Det er et krav, at udviklingsperioden maksimalt må have en varighed på 6 måneder samt, at implementeringsperioden maksimalt må have en varighed på 6 måneder. Det nuværende system håndterer ca. 25.000 Brugere og 2.800 Puljekøretøjer. I kontraktperioden forventes løsningen som udgangspunkt at skulle kunne håndtere op til ca. 5.000 Puljekøretøjer. Henset til den usikre internationale sikkerhedspolitiske situation har Forsvaret imidlertid behov for en option på at kunne skalere løsningen, således at Applikationen og den tilhørende infrastruktur efter Kundens anmodning kan udbygges til at håndtere op mod 10.000 Puljekøretøjer uden forringelse af funktionalitet, svartider, tilgængelighed eller de øvrige i kontrakten fastsatte krav og servicemål. Herudover omfatter kontrakten en option vedrørende valg af adgangsteknologi til Puljekøretøjerne, hvorefter Kunden i stedet for at anvende Forsvarets eksisterende adgangsbærere (RFID mv.) kan vælge et adgangs- og låsesystem leveret af Leverandøren på de i kravspecifikationen og kontrakten fastsatte vilkår.

title: Indkøb af maling og overfladebehandlingsmaterialer - Technical Education Copenhagen
description: Udbud af rammeaftale vedrørende indkøb af maling og overfladebehandlingsmaterialer, til TECs elever/kursister i forbindelse med deres gennemførelse af kurser/uddannelse. Udbudsbetingelserne beskriver processen for udbuddet og fastsætter retningslinjerne for afgivelse af tilbud, kommunikation mellem tilbudsgiver og ordregiver samt oplysninger om udbudsprocessen i øvrigt. Rammeaftalebilag 2: Kravspecifikation indeholder en uddybende beskrivelse af krav til produkter/sortiment. Rammeaftalens forventede årlige værdi udgør 900.000 DKK. Rammeaftalens maksimale værdi er 5.400.000 DKK. TEC (Technical Education Copenhagen) er en af Danmarks største udbydere af erhvervsuddannelser og efteruddannelse inden for tekniske fagområder. Inden for bygningsmaleruddannelsen samt tilhørende AMU- og efteruddannelsesforløb er materialer en central del af undervisningen. Som leverandør af maling til TEC bliver man en del af uddannelsen af fremtidens bygningsmalere. Produkterne indgår i den daglige praktik, hvor elever og kursister opbygger deres faglige kompetencer, teknik og materialeforståelse. Undervisningen er praksisnær og afspejler branchens virkelighed. Det betyder, at de anvendte produkter skal være relevante, tidssvarende og repræsentative for det, eleverne møder i deres fremtidige arbejdsliv. Som leverandør til TEC får man dermed mulighed for at introducere produkter tidligt i faglærtes karriere og bidrage til deres kendskab og præferencer. TEC uddanner årligt et stort antal elever og kursister, som efterfølgende indgår i byggebranchen. Som leverandør til TEC opnår man således en bred kontaktflade til fremtidens faglærte gennem direkte anvendelse i undervisningen. Se og læs mere om den ordregivende myndighed på: https://www.tec.dk/

title: Klimaundersøkelse Trondheim - Klimaløftene 2024-2026
description: 1 Generelt om oppdragetTrondheim kommune, heretter kalt oppdragsgiver, innbyr til åpen tilbudskonkurranse for å anskaffe "Klimaundersøkelse Trondheim - Klimaløftene 2024-2030".Konkurransen kunngjøres i DOFFIN, se www.doffin.no, gjennom oppdragsgiverens konkurransegjennomføringsverktøy (KGV) Mercell. Konkurransen gjennomføres i henhold til lov om offentlige anskaffelser av 17. juni 2016 nr. 73 (LOA) og forskrift om offentlige anskaffelser av 18. august 2016 nr. 974 (FOA). For denne anskaffelsen gjelder forskriftens del I og de føringer gitt i dette dokumentet.2 BakgrunnTrondheim kommune har behov for å knytte til seg en leverandør som kan gjennomføre en årlig oppfølgingsundersøkelse blant et representativt utvalg av Trondheims befolkning over 15 år. Utvalget skal ha minimum 1000 respondenter og skal være representativt med tanke på kjønn, alder, utdanningsnivå og bosted/bydel. Undersøkelsen skal gi innsikt i innbyggernes holdninger og selvrapporterte adferd knyttet til kommunens gjeldende kommunedelplan for energi og klima, "Klimaløftene" (vedlegg 1).Undersøkelsen blir den niende i rekken av årlige undersøkelser, og flere av spørsmålene er beholdt. Det er avgjørende for kommunen at metodikken muliggjør sammenligning av data over tid for å identifisere viktige utviklingstrekk. I 2024/2025 ble strukturen på undersøkelsen og flere av spørsmålene endret for å samsvare med ny vedtatt energi- og klimaplan, samtidig som metoden ble endret fra telefonintervju til web-panel. Gjeldende spørsmålsbatteri er vedlagt (vedlegg 2).Resultatene skal bidra til å gi innsikt i innbyggernes forståelse av - og forhold til - klimatiltak, og vil inngå som beslutningsgrunnlag for kommunens videre klimaarbeid. Undersøkelsen skal også bidra til en bedre målgruppeforståelse (utdype våre personas) og supplere kunnskapsgrunnlaget for mer treffsikker klimakommunikasjon.

title: Rough River LakeAxtel Wastewater Treatment Plant Replacement
description: Description of Proposed Work: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Louisville District, anticipates issuing an Invitation for Bids (IFB) for a firm-fixed-price construction contract to execute the Rough River Lake Axtel Wastewater Treatment Plant Replacement. The overall scope of work comprises the complete demolition and decommissioning of the existing wastewater treatment plant and the construction of a new replacement subsurface sewage treatment and dispersal facility. Primary features of work include, but are not limited to:Demolition and Removal: Demolition and disposal of the existing Axtel Wastewater Treatment Plant, existing chain-link perimeter fencing, and gravel surfacing.Treatment and Disposal System Construction: Construction and installation of a new subsurface wastewater treatment and disposal system, including: Precast concrete primary pretreatment septic tanks conforming to ASTM C1227 and 902 KAR 10:081/085. Precast sewage lift stations, dose stations, and holding tanks. Packaged Aerobic Treatment Unit (ATU) / Advanced Wastewater Treatment System. Soil drip dispersal field and piping network.Piping and Distribution: Installation of gravity sewer piping and pressure piping networks, including supply/return manifolds, flush valves, and air release/vacuum breaker valves.Electrical and Control Systems: Complete electrical service and distribution, including coordination with Meade County RECC for service drop/upgrades, NEMA 4X (316 stainless steel) control enclosures, UL 1449 Type 2 Surge Protective Devices (TVSS), sequencing reactor controls, alarm systems, and associated conduits.Site and Civil Appurtenances: Rough and finish grading, trenching, erosion and sediment control measures, replacement chain-link perimeter security fence and gates with privacy slats, and site restoration.Optional Features: Contract Line Item Schedule includes an optional line item for Rock Excavation (unit-priced per cubic yard).

title: Imaging of Southern Nova Scotia coastline using ShoreZone methodologies
description: Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO) requires coastal imaging services in support of the Canadian Coast Guard's Area Response Planning (ARP) initiative under the Oceans Protection Plan (OPP) 2.0. The objective of this project is to apply imaging methodologies consistent with the ShoreZone Coastal Imaging and Habitat Mapping Protocol (Cook et al., 2017) to expand existing coastal habitat datasets in southern Nova Scotia. The work will involve the acquisition of coastal imagery and video data along approximately 1,750 km of Nova Scotia coastline, beginning near Lobster Bay and extending northward toward Halifax. The resulting data will support oil spill preparedness, planning, and response activities by improving the availability of geographically specific coastal habitat information. Contractors must conduct all imaging and video collection in accordance with the ShoreZone Coastal Imaging and Habitat Mapping Protocol and the requirements specified in the solicitation documents. Complete details of the requirement are contained in the Request for Proposal (RFP) documents.

title: Leiri- ja kurssikeskusvaraukset
description: Kesälukioseura järjestää Suomessa asuville pakolaislapsille ja -nuorille leirimuotoisia oman äidinkielen ja kulttuurin kursseja. Kesälukioseura etsii vuoden 2027 kursseja varten leiri- ja kurssikeskuksia eri puolilta Suomea. Kurssit ajoittuvat koulujen loma-ajoille (talvilomaviikko 8, kesä–heinäkuu). Oman äidinkielen ja kulttuurin kursseja järjestetään 8–9 (1–2 talvella, seitsemän kesällä). Kesän kurssit ovat pituudeltaan vajaan viikon mittaisia (5 vrk, esim. ma–la). Talvilomaleirin kesto on 4 vrk, ma-pe. Kursseille osallistuu noin 20–32 iältään 7–14-vuotiasta lasta sekä 4–7 omakielistä opettajaa. Jokaiselle osallistujalle pitää olla leirin aikana vuodepaikka (ei patjamajoitusta). Kesälukioseura vastaa kurssien järjestämisestä. Kurssien ohjaajatiimit vastaavat kurssien opetuksesta ja ohjelmasta. Kurssien järjestämisestä aiheutuvat kulut katetaan sosiaali- ja terveysministeriön myöntämällä avustuksella. Avustusta haetaan vuosittain, ja vuoden 2027 avustuspäätös selviää alkuvuodesta 2027. Hankinnan vertailuperusteina ovat turvallisuus, kokonaisedullisuus, luonnonläheisyys, kulkuyhteydet, riittävät opetus- ja harrastetilat, majoitus ja ylläpito sekä ajankohta. Tarjouksen voi tehdä yhdestä tai useammasta kurssiviikosta. Tarjouksesta tulee käydä ilmi ajankohta, jota tarjous koskee.

description: Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) Energy is issuing a Request for Proposal (RFP) for Alongside Aircraft Refueling Services to include managing, maintaining, and operating Government Owned, Contractor-Operated (GOCO) facilities and equipment at Cannon, AFB, NM, Holloman AFB, NM, Davis Monthan AFB, AZ, and Luke AFB, AZ. The Contractor will ensure safe, accurate, and timely handling, quality control, and accountability of all Defense Wide Working Capital Fund (DWWCF)-owned petroleum products under their control. The Contractor will perform required maintenance to ensure facilities, associated systems, vehicles, and equipment remain operational to meet the base mission. The Contractor will comply with environmental protection, safety, and security directives. The Contractor will conduct required training to ensure personnel are fully qualified to perform Performance Work Statement (PWS) tasks. The Contractor shall conduct all necessary fuels operations to support base operations, airshows and special events, deployments, exercises, and contingencies under normal conditions, as well as, during periods of heightened security, inclement weather, or other unique situations. Operations must be safely and efficiently conducted to receive, store, transfer, issue, and account for products with appropriate controls to ensure fuel quality, maintain inventory accuracy, and ensure no environmental impact. The Contractor shall operate and maintain the self-service automated service station facilities, equipment, and systems and ensure sufficient product is available to provide 24 hours a day, seven days a week support of ground fuels. The Contractor shall perform required tasks to ensure fuel is properly accounted for and issued to only authorized users. This procurement will be 100% set aside for Service-Disabled Veteran Owned Business (SDVOSB) under NAICS code 493190 (Other Warehouse and Storage). The Government anticipates issuing one solicitation and awarding four (4) firm fixed-price contracts for Cannon AFB, NM, Holloman AFB, NM, Davis Monthan AFB, AZ, and Luke AFB, AZ. These requirements will be for a four-year base period (December 01, 2026 � November 30, 2030), a five-year option period (December 01, 2030 � November 30, 2035), and a option to extend the contract s for up to six individual months (December 01, 2035 � May 31, 2036).This procurement will be solicited under full and open competition after exclusion of sources. The solicitation will be published electronically on the SAM website at https://sam.gov/. Dates of the Pre-Preproposal conference, in conjunction with the site visits, will be listed in the solicitation or via amendment. description: The Marine Corps Logistics Command intends to award a sole-source contract to Phillips Corporation, Federal Division, for Performance Assurance, preventive maintenance, inspection, testing, and related maintenance support services for Government-owned industrial manufacturing equipment located at Production Plant Barstow, Yermo Annex, Yermo, California. Phillips Corporation, Federal Division, is the only authorized source capable of providing Performance Assurance services for the Haas and OMAX equipment covered by this requirement. The Government�s current intent is to include additional equipment manufactured by companies other than Haas and OMAX under the same contract for contract-administration convenience, coordinated scheduling, continuity of service, centralized accountability, and mitigation of performance and operational risks. The anticipated scope includes scheduled Performance Assurance services, preventive maintenance, equipment inspections, functional assessments, calibration analysis, vibration analysis, geometry inspections, Renishaw ballbar testing, drawbar force testing, OMAX annual waterjet services, replacement of specifically included maintenance components, equipment-condition reporting, and recommendations for follow-on corrective maintenance or spare parts. However, before making a final acquisition determination, the Government is conducting market research to determine whether qualified sources exist to service the covered equipment manufactured by companies other than Haas and OMAX and whether separating that portion of the requirement would be in the Government�s best interest. This notice is not a request for quotations or proposals. Responsible sources may submit capability statements addressing only their ability to provide Performance Assurance services for the covered equipment manufactured by companies other than Haas and OMAX. Responses concerning the Haas and OMAX equipment are not requested. Capability statements must clearly demonstrate the firm�s ability to: Service the applicable equipment manufactured by LVD/Strippit, Cincinnati, Fadal, Trumpf, Hyundai-Kia Machine, and Hardinge; Identify the specific manufacturers, equipment models, and services the firm is capable of supporting; Provide qualified personnel with applicable OEM training, certifications, authorizations, or demonstrated experience; Perform the required preventive maintenance, inspections, functional testing, condition assessments, and reporting; Provide all required labor, supervision, tools, diagnostic equipment, travel, maintenance components, and technical expertise; and Meet applicable OEM requirements, manufacturer-recommended maintenance practices, and technician qualification requirements. Interested sources must submit their capability statements electronically to GySgt Matthew Radi at matthew.radi@usmc.mil no later than 25 September 2026 at 9:00 am EDT Submissions must include, at a minimum: Company name and address; Unique Entity Identifier and CAGE Code; Business size and applicable socioeconomic status; Point of contact information; Specific manufacturers and equipment models the firm can service; Applicable OEM authorizations, certifications, or technician qualifications; Relevant experience performing similar services; and Sufficient technical information for the Government to evaluate the firm�s capability. The Government will use the information received solely for acquisition-planning and market-research purposes, including determining whether it is in the Government�s best interest to separate the non-Haas and non-OMAX equipment from the contemplated Phillips sole-source contract. If the Government determines that separating the requirement is not practicable or in its best interest, it may proceed with an integrated sole-source award to Phillips Corporation, Federal Division. A determination regarding whether to separate any portion of the requirement is solely within the Government�s discretion. The Government will not reimburse respondents for any costs associated with preparing or submitting a capability statement. The Government is not obligated to acknowledge responses, conduct discussions, or award a contract as a result of this notice.

title: W1941-260007-2_Forklift fleet management system
description: This solicitation of offers cancels and supersedes previous solicitation of offers number Doc5300321557 dated November 18, 2025 with a closing date of January 30, 2026 at 2PM EST. A debriefing or feedback session will be provided upon request to Offeror's who offered on the previous solicitation of offers. Public Works and Government Services Canada (PWGSC), on behalf of the Department of National Defence, is issuing this request for proposal (RFP) for the acquisition of a forklift fleet management system including software, delivery and installation located in Montréal, Québec, Canada, as detailed in Annex “Statement of Requirements”.

title: W6896-25S092 Grounds Maintenance Services
description: Please note that late submissions will not be considered or accepted. Solicitation of Offer Submission Eligibility. This solicitation of offers is subject to the Policy on Reciprocal Procurement. This means that only Canadian Suppliers, and Suppliers of an Applicable Trading Partner, as defined in the Annex Solicitation of Offers Definitions, are eligible for this solicitation of offers. Offers submitted by Suppliers of a Non-Trading Partner will be rejected. The Department of National Defence has a requirement for ongoing grounds maintenance services including grass cutting, vegetation control, landscaping, tree services, pest control, fencing support, and aggregate supply on an “if and when” requested basis to support the ongoing operational, safety, and appearance requirements at the Canadian Forces Base (CFB) Shilo, in Shilo, Manitoba. The estimated period of the Standing Offer Agreement (SOA) is from October 13, 2026 to October 12, 2029, with two (2), 1-year option periods to extend the SOA from October 13, 2029 to October 12, 2030 and October 13, 2030 to October 12, 2031.

title: 50100-269137-B – RISO - Fresh Bread – CSC
description: Notice to suppliers: This solicitation of offers is subject to the Policy on Reciprocal Procurement. This means that only Canadian Suppliers and Suppliers of an Applicable Trading Partner, as defined in the Annex Solicitation of Offers Definitions, are eligible for this solicitation of offers. Offers submitted by Suppliers of a Non-Trading Partner will be rejected. Please note that late submissions will not be considered or accepted. Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC), on behalf the Correctional Service of Canada, has a requirement for geographically zone based Regional Individual Standing Offer for the supply, delivery and offloading of various quantities of Fresh Bread and Bakery Products to kitchens, on an “as and when requested basis” for the period of the Standing Offer.
